surface: Mapbox, MapLibre, and Mapbox legacy entry points with Map, Marker, Popup, controls, Source, Layer, MapProvider, useMap, useControl, engine-specific refs, events, and style types.
divergences: Refs are passed as ordinary props instead of React forwardRef wrappers.
React StrictMode's development-only double mount is not reproduced; lifecycle cleanup is tested directly.
The mapbox-legacy entry reuses the modern Octane component layer and is validated separately against mapbox-gl 1.13.0 rather than preserving React implementation details.
ssr: The component renders its container during SSR and imports/constructs the selected WebGL map library only in a client effect. Child map components mount after the map instance is available.
